text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Fitted black crewneck T-shirt, cream loose cargo trousers with large thigh pockets, black low shoes conservatively completed as feet cropped.. Add ONLY these accessories: Black narrow rectangular sunglasses with dark lenses, both temples visible in three-quarter product view.; A structured tan leather tote with darker brown long handles and small metal hardware.; One classic silver metal bracelet wristwatch with simple light dial, shown alone.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Edit this exact product photo. Remove ONLY the brown leather waist belt and its metal buckle completely, leaving the cream cargo trousers' plain fabric waistband. Preserve everything else exactly: black T-shirt, cream cargo trousers, black shoes, sunglasses, tan bag and silver watch. White background, hollow empty clothing, no person or mannequin, full uncropped view. Add nothing.
